chunks: Ibn Muskan narrated from al-Halabi, who said:
I said to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: A man performed tawaf around the House, then shortened one circuit in the Hijr. What should he do?
He said: "He repeats that one circuit."

key_terms.بِالْبَيْتِ: around the Sacred House, meaning the Ka'bah
key_terms.فِي الْحِجْرِ: through the Hijr area adjacent to the Ka'bah

ai.seo_question: What should someone do if one circuit of tawaf was shortened by passing through the Hijr?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning tawaf during hajj or ʿumrah. If a person cuts through the Hijr and thereby shortens one circuit of tawaf, that circuit is invalid and must be repeated.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2806 - Ibn Muskan narrated from al-Halabi, who said:
I said to Abu Abdullah (as), "A man performed tawaf around the Kaaba but shortened one circuit by passing through the Hijr (Hijr Ismail). What should he do?"
Imam (as) said: "He must repeat that one circuit."
